text: Who are the best Microsoft Power Platform consultants in Perth? Give me a shortlist of reputable Power Platform consulting partners with reasons.

sections.text:
A strong Perth shortlist is **Velrada, Professional Advantage, SSW, Power Platform Experts, Ultron Developments, and Avenue Group Australia**. The right choice depends on whether you need enterprise transformation, Microsoft-stack integration, or a smaller local team for focused automation work.

- **Velrada** — Best for large or complex organisations. It is Perth-based and positioned as a Microsoft partner with capabilities spanning cloud, business insights, workforce productivity, operations, Dynamics 365 and Power Platform.[3][10] Choose Velrada for enterprise governance, data, customer-experience or digital-transformation programs.

- **Professional Advantage** — Best for Power Platform integrated with existing Microsoft systems. It is a Microsoft Solutions Partner for Modern Work and Tier 1 CSP, with services covering Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI and integration with Dynamics 365, Teams and SharePoint.[8] It is a sensible option where implementation, licensing, support and managed services need to come from one established provider.

- **SSW** — Best for software engineering depth and custom solutions. SSW reports more than 1,000 clients across 15 countries, around 100 consultants in four countries, Microsoft certifications, MVPs and a Microsoft Regional Director.[4] It suits organisations that need Power Platform combined with custom development, architecture or broader Microsoft consulting.

- **Power Platform Experts** — Best for specialist Power Platform delivery. Its Perth offering covers Microsoft-certified consultants, Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Pages, automation, dashboards, training and ongoing support.[7] Consider it for a focused Power Platform project where specialist platform knowledge matters more than a large systems-integrator footprint.

- **Ultron Developments** — Best for practical, tailored workflow and app development. Ultron specifically targets Perth and WA organisations, including operations, resources and professional-services teams, with emphasis on replacing spreadsheets, improving approvals, audit trails and reporting.[1] It may be a good fit for a smaller or mid-market business wanting a hands-on local-context delivery style.

- **Avenue Group Australia** — Best for a Perth-based strategy-to-support engagement. Avenue describes itself as Perth-based and offers Power Platform alongside Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Dynamics 365, AI, automation, change management and analytics; it also states that it has certified Power Platform specialists and 25+ years of global expertise.[6][9] Its delivery model is worth considering when Power Platform is part of a broader digital-transformation or AI program.

## Quick recommendation

- **Enterprise transformation:** Velrada or SSW  
- **Microsoft 365/Dynamics integration and managed support:** Professional Advantage  
- **Dedicated Power Platform specialist:** Power Platform Experts  
- **Focused local automation or custom app work:** Ultron Developments  
- **Power Platform combined with AI, Dynamics or change management:** Avenue Group Australia  

Before appointing one, ask for two recent Perth or WA references, named consultant certifications, examples using Dataverse and governance, a clear approach to licensing and environments, and an itemised estimate separating discovery, build, testing, training and support.
